top_signals.title: Seven Sailors Missing After Chemical Tankers Struck Near Romania
top_signals.summary: Rescuers searched on Thursday for seven missing sailors after drones struck two chemical tankers near Romania's Black Sea coast, setting them ablaze and raising fresh security concerns along a vital shipping route used by Ukraine.Romanian President…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
